{{Quote|Here in the Shadowlands Rothrrrawr fought the Great Beast.|translated=1|Freyyr, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''Great Beast''' was a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] that lived in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] until the amnesiac [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] [[Death|slew]] it in [[3956 BBY]]. During the long [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that preceded its demise, the Great Beast killed many individuals who had come to challenge it, including the Jedi [[Guun Han Saresh]] and the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Rothrrrawr]].

==Biography==
===Beast of the Shadowlands===
{{Quote|There is a place of ritual south of here. If the Great Beast is to be lured out of hiding, it must be done there, using the old ways.|translated=1|Freyyr, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:Shadowlands-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ritual site in the Shadowlands]]
The creature that came to be known as the Great Beast was a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] that [[Diet/Legends|fed]] on the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] of those who were strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> Such beasts were originally created by the [[Ninûshwodzakut]], or "Knotters of Entrails," a group of [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Kissai|priests]] who engineered monstruous animals through arcane [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] processes.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

Long before the [[Jedi Civil War]] that pitted the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], the creature found its way to the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the dark and dangerous ground level that lay at the foot of the mile-high [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] found on that [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Eventually, the presence of the terentatek sparked the interest of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], a race of [[Hair/Legends|hairy]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] native to the arboreal world.<ref name="KOTOR" /> In their society, warriors were tasked with raiding the Shadowlands to protect the civilians from the predators that roamed below their treehouses.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> On rare occasions, the Wookiees also visited the Shadowlands for ritual reasons such as [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|coming-of-age tests]].<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> Dubbed "the Great Beast," the Kashyyykian terentatek was made the central piece of a ritual battle. The warriors who wished to prove their worth in combat would travel to the [[Ritual site|creature's lair]] and lure it out by tying the corpse of a [[Kinrath/Legends|viper kinrath]] to a dangling [[kshyy vine]]. Attracted by the smell of [[Blood/Legends|blood]], the Great Beast would turn up, eat the bait and attack the warrior who had summoned it. Although many ambitious Wookiees attempted to kill the creature, few survived the encounter. Despite its dangerousness, the ritual was formalized, as a marker bearing precise instructions was placed under the dangling vine.<ref name="KOTOR" />

===Killing the hunter===
{{Quote|The hunt goes on.|Guun Han Saresh|<ref name="shadows">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref>}}
[[File:CleansingofKashyyyk-ShadowsandLight.jpg|thumb|200px|The Great Beast attacked Guun Han Saresh]]
In [[3997 BBY]], a young student of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] named [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] discovered the teachings of the nefarious [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sect and was seduced by them. With a [[Brotherhood of the Sith|group]] of fellow defrocked [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], he founded his own [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Kun started to wage [[Great Sith War/Legends|war]] against the Jedi Order and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the galaxy-spanning governement that the Jedi strove to protect. In hopes of winning the war, Kun engineered various [[Sithspawn/Legends|mutant creatures]] through arcane [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] processes. Among those dreaded Sithspawns were terentateks similar to the Great Beast. When the war was over, several Jedi Knights participated in the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], a collective Jedi effort to eliminate those creatures. In that context, a young Jedi named [[Guun Han Saresh]] traveled to Kashyyyk, having heard that a Great Beast lived in the Shadowlands.<ref name="shadows" /> The Great Beast, however, had been fought by many generations of Wookiees prior to Saresh's arrival, proving that it had been born long before the rise of Kun's Sith Empire.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Regardless the creature's true origins, Saresh attempted to take it down. The Jedi, although he did use a bait trick similar to the one described in the Wookiee ritual, did not use the ritual marker and hung a freshly killed [[Bat/Legends|batlike]] [[Mykal/Legends|mykal]] instead of a kinrath. The Great Beast still fell into the trap, ready to feast on the corpse. At the beginning, the creature could not see Saresh, who had been waiting for its arrival on some high rocks. The Jedi, armed with a [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|Force-imbued blade]], emerged from his perch and stroke a piercing blow to the terentatek. The blade, however, was not solid enough for the creature's thick hide, and it was shattered to the hilt. Taking advantage of Saresh's surprise, the Great Beast dropped down on the young Jedi and killed him.<ref name="shadows" />

===Breaking the Blade===
{{Quote|He sought a challenge, but his arrogance got him more than he could handle. He survived, but the blade of the sword stayed in the creature's hide.|translated=1|Freyyr, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
About a generation before the end of the Jedi Civil War, the Great Beast found a new opponent in the person of [[Rothrrrawr]], the [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] of the Wookiee [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]. The chieftain followed the ritual to summon the creature and confronted it, holding the [[Bacca's Ceremonial Blade|Ceremonial Blade]] of his ancestor [[Bacca]]. However, Rothrrrawr had been blinded by ambition, and the beast proved to be too strong for him. The chieftain managed to lodge his sword on the creature's side, which gave it great pain but only caused surface damage. Rothrrrawr survived the battle, proving luckier than the late Saresh, but losing the blade of his ancestral weapon. From that day on, the Great Beast was forced to live with an injury even as skin started to regrow around the blade.<ref name="KOTOR" />

===Meeting its doom===
In the year [[3956 BBY]], as the Jedi Civil War was drawing to a close, an amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] visited Kashyyyk in search of a [[Star Map]] that would help him find the [[Star Forge]]. During his journey in the Shadowlands, he discovered the ritual marker and followed its instructions, which prompted the Great Beast to appear. For the first time in its long existence, the terentatek met its match. With the help of two companions, Revan slew the Great Beast and recovered the blade of Bacca's sword.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The beast is cunning. It will not appear if there is an overwhelming number waiting to slay it.|translated=1|Freyyr, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
As with all Terentatek, the Great Beast had a hulking frame and was armed with prominent tusks and claws. Although [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], the creature was still crafty, as it avoided to appear before more than one potential adversary at a time.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Power and abilities==
Thanks to the venomous claws of his species, the Great Beast could [[Poison/Legends|poison]] its adversaries by simply slashing at them. When swiping violently at its opponent, the terentatek could knock him or her backwards.<ref name="KOTOR" />
